name: Gershon
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Of Gershon were the families of the Libnites and the Shimites, numbered 7,500 males from a month old and upward, and they pitched behind the tabernacle westward. Depending on your family lineage you had a specific side of the tabernacle that you and all your descendants had to be on.

note.label: Numbers 3: The Levites Taken Instead of the Firstborn

points: The charge of the sons of Gershon was the tabernacle and the tent, the covering thereof, the hanging for the door, the hangings of the court, and the cords of it; that was their responsibility.

note.label: Numbers 3: The Levites Taken Instead of the Firstborn

points: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities out of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, and the children of Merari had twelve cities out of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun; all given by lot as the Most High commanded by the hand of Moses.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: The children of Gershon received Golan in Bashan out of the other half tribe of Manasseh to be a city of refuge for the slayer, four cities out of Issachar, four out of Asher, and out of Naphtali three, including Kedesh in Galilee, a city of refuge: thirteen cities in all.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: The sons of Levi are named, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and the line runs through Kohath and Amram to Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: The sons of Levi are set down again by their families: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, with the sons that came from each.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: David divided the Levites into courses among the sons of Levi, namely Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and named their families and their sons in order down the line. He names the father and then names the children, and then names that one's children, going down the line, which is like an inheritance each of them received.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites
